notes: Only the booklet's main model (Venice skyline) is built; all 212 parts are accounted for (194 top-level parts + 2 domes x 9 parts in the repeat).
Part identification from element numbers and pictures: e.g. 4224792 = lego-49668 (tooth), 6023806 = lego-93273 (curved), 4523556 = lego-62361 (arched mudguard).

Which exact studs a piece sits on is often not determinable from the small isometric pictures, so the edges mark which piece rests on which, not the exact stud ports. Port names are given only where the connection is clearly side-stud, pin-hole, or bar.
Black base: black tiles (b27, b29-b32) are taken as attached to the side studs of the 87609 plates; the exact assignment of each tile is approximate.
The two Basilica dome sub-assemblies (pages 71 and 74) are one repeat; copy 2 attaches to b117 instead of b116. The slope placement is mirrored in the second dome but not modelled.
The two Technic bricks with teeth (b136, b137) and the two headlight bricks (b142, b143) sit on the arches (b118-b120). The central dome sub-assembly (b146-b155) sits on b115 behind the panel.
The cone (b179) sits on the 3688 roof (b180), which has no stud port in the catalogue, so the ports are left null.
Ids b1-b130 follow build order up to the first Basilica dome; b131-b194 continue in build order after the domes, which are in the repeat.
